title: Exposition Vallauris
medium: Linocut in colors on Arches paper

said.q: Picasso transforms text into imagery, using playful lines and rich coloration that enhance the graphic elements of the work. Simple in concept yet bold in execution, this piece is a perfect example of Picasso’s extraordinary mastery of the linocut technique—often regarded by other artists as difficult and unwieldy.

events.n: created as a poster to promote the exhibition
events.q: This linocut was created by Picasso as a poster to promote the 1964 Vallauris Exhibition.
Printer and Publisher: Hidalgo Arnéra, Vallauris
